policies.policy_name: Bebas Visa Kunjungan (BVK) — Visit Visa Exemption
policies.description: Visa-free short visit for citizens of 19 countries/special-administrative-region governments plus foreign holders of Singapore permanent residence entering via designated checkpoints. Stay is a maximum of 30 days and cannot be extended or converted to another stay permit. Base regulation Perpres 95/2024; Brazil and Turkey added by Permenimipas 9/2025 effective 2025-07-03; Peru, Kazakhstan, Macau SAR and Belarus added by Permenimipas 10/2026 (Berita Negara 2026 No. 463, promulgated 2026-07-09). Permitted purposes include tourism, business meetings, and medical treatment.
conditions: Maximum 30 days, non-extendable, non-convertible
Singapore permanent residents (any nationality) qualify only through designated immigration checkpoints

unresolved: Calling Visa (AFG, ISR, PRK, LBR, NGA, SOM): official pages list the subject countries but not the application procedure or channel; no disposition row was recorded for these six nationalities, and the ALL_OTHERS eVisa row explicitly excludes them. This is the main reason for research_status=research_incomplete.

Blank-page rule (min 1 blank page) and the sponsor requirement for non-VOA/non-exempt nationalities are sourced only from the official Embassy of Indonesia (Washington DC) site consular.embassyofindonesia.org, which is official but not a .go.id domain and still displays COVID-era requirements (vaccination proof, PeduliLindungi) that appear outdated.

List-size discrepancy between channels: imigrasi.go.id 'Daftar Subjek Visa on Arrival' lists 97 countries, while the e-VOA eligibility list on evisa.imigrasi.go.id lists 87 (e.g., San Marino appears only on the e-VOA list; Guatemala, Kenya, Mauritius, Mongolia, Mozambique, Papua New Guinea, Rwanda, Tanzania, Venezuela appear only on the 97-country list). All 16 focus nationalities (CHN, USA, GBR, IND, SGP, HKG, TWN, JPN, KOR, DEU, FRA, AUS, CAN, RUS, ARE, BRA) appear on both lists. Treated as an online-vs-border channel difference, not a conflict.
Macau (MAC) is on the visa-free (BVK) list but does not appear on the fetched 97-country VOA subject list.
kemlu.go.id (foreign ministry) homepage is JavaScript-rendered; no visa content could be extracted, so no MOFA-specific visa page is cited.
Indonesian Embassy in Berlin (indonesianembassy.de) was unreachable (connection refused), so it could not be used as a corroborating consular source.
The VFS Global e-VOA site (indonesiavoa.vfsevisa.id) surfaced in search results but no official .go.id page linking to it was fetched, so it was excluded from portals.

Regulation number behind the current 97-country VOA list was not stated on the fetched list page; effective-date evidence exists only for the BVK additions (Permenimipas 9/2025 effective 2025-07-03; Permenimipas 10/2026 promulgated 2026-07-09, Berita Negara 2026 No. 463).
